home.introTitle: A haven of warmth, sea breezes, and private gardens.
home.introBody: Nestled along the calm coastline of Bali, Sagara Villas offers boutique standalone units designed for restorative stays. Each villa pairs natural timber, shaded stone terraces, and personal space.
home.featuredSub: Discover our hand-crafted sanctuaries, thoughtfully prepared for couples, families, and quiet getaways.
home.pillar1Desc: Morning ocean breeze, mature frangipani courtyards, and secluded verandas designed for slow mornings.
home.pillar2Desc: Independent villas with private plunge pools, sun decks, stone soaking tubs, and serene garden walls.
home.pillar3Desc: Warm, personal hospitality. Every inquiry is verified and confirmed directly by our resident team.
home.locationBody: Positioned just moments from the shoreline, away from bustling corridors yet close to quiet beaches and local dining.
home.ctaTitle: Ready for an unhurried coastal stay?
home.ctaBody: Submit a booking request with your preferred dates. Our team will verify availability and respond personally.

bookPage.title: Booking Request
bookPage.subtitle: Submit your dates and guest details. Our team checks calendar availability personally and replies with confirmation details.
bookPage.importantNotice: Important: Submitting this form creates a PENDING inquiry. It does NOT charge your card or immediately confirm your reservation.
bookPage.specialRequestsPlaceholder: Estimated arrival time, dietary notes, cot request…
bookPage.privacyLabel: I acknowledge that this is an inquiry request. My details will be stored to process this booking. Final confirmation and payment instructions will be delivered by the Sagara Villas host.
bookPage.successSubtitle: Thank you for choosing Sagara Villas.
bookPage.nextStepsP1: 1. Our operations team will review your requested dates on the live calendar.
bookPage.nextStepsP2: 2. We will reach out to {email} within 24 hours with availability confirmation and payment instructions.
bookPage.nextStepsP3: 3. No payment has been taken today. Once confirmed, you can arrange your deposit securely.

aboutPage.title: About Sagara Villas
aboutPage.subtitle: Crafted for unhurried coastal retreats, mindful architecture, and quiet comfort.
aboutPage.storyP1: Sagara Villas was conceived as an antidote to crowded resorts. Designed around private courtyards, natural ocean light, and indigenous timber, our boutique villas provide a sanctuary where time moves at the pace of the tides.
aboutPage.storyP2: Every detail — from the positioning of bedroom verandas to shaded outdoor soaking baths — is crafted to invite rest, focus, and quiet appreciation of coastal Bali.
aboutPage.architectureBody: Built with locally quarried stone, reclaimed teak, and airy high-pitched ceilings that catch the afternoon sea breeze, our units balance traditional craftsmanship with modern retreat comforts.
aboutPage.hospitalityBody: With only a select few standalone villas, our on-site team provides discreet, thoughtful service. We respect your solitude while remaining on hand whenever needed.

locationPage.title: Location & Coastal Setting
locationPage.subtitle: Tucked away along Bali's serene coast, close to water, breezes, and quiet roads.
locationPage.settingBody: Sagara Villas is located in coastal Bali, positioned a short walk from tranquil sand shores and away from high-density tourist clusters. The area retains its village rhythm with quiet warungs, coconut groves, and sea views.
locationPage.airportNote: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) is approximately 60–75 minutes by car depending on traffic. Airport transfer can be arranged upon request.
locationPage.surrounding1: Peaceful coastal walking paths (2 minutes walk)
locationPage.surrounding2: Local beachfront dining & fresh seafood (5 minutes drive)
locationPage.surrounding3: Quiet surf breaks & sunset vantage points (10 minutes drive)
locationPage.demoNotice: Demonstration Note: Address and coordinates are illustrative for this portfolio project.

reservationForm.pageSubtitle: Record a walk-in, phone, WhatsApp, or direct staff reservation. Prices are calculated and snapshotted on save.
reservationForm.guestHelper: Existing guests are matched automatically by normalized email or phone number (BR-15).

reservationDetail.checkInEarlyOverride: Allow early check-in before scheduled arrival date (audited)
reservationDetail.cancelDialogDescription: Cancelling releases the blocked unit dates immediately. Existing payments are preserved and flagged if a refund is due.
reservationDetail.noFurtherTransitions: This reservation is in a terminal status ({status}) with no further status transitions.
reservationDetail.versionConflictBody: This reservation was modified in another session. Reload the latest version before saving changes.
reservationDetail.editSectionSubtitle: Updating dates, unit, or discount re-validates availability and recalculates the snapshotted price.

paymentPanel.title: Manual Payments & Balance
paymentPanel.subtitle: Payment status is derived automatically from non-voided payments minus refunds (BR-09).
paymentPanel.overpaidWarningBody: Net payments exceed the reservation total by {amount}. Record a refund or verify the ledger entries.
paymentPanel.refundPendingBody: This cancelled reservation still has a positive net paid balance of {amount} (BR-11).
paymentPanel.voidDialogDescription: Payments are never deleted. Voiding strikes through the entry, records your reason in the audit log, and recomputes the reservation payment status.
paymentPanel.emptyPayments: No payments or refunds have been recorded for this reservation yet.

auditTrail.title: Audit Trail
auditTrail.subtitle: Immutable operational log of all reservation and payment actions.

guestDetail.anonymizeDialogDescription: This permanently scrubs the guest's name, email, phone, country, and notes while preserving linked reservation and payment ledgers (DATABASE §11).

unitDetail.slugHelp: Slug cannot be changed once the unit is ACTIVE or ARCHIVED (API.md §5.1).
unitDetail.archiveDialogDescription: Archiving hides the unit from catalog and booking requests. This action is blocked if future reservations exist.
unitDetail.deleteImageConfirmDescription: This will remove the image from the unit gallery and asset manifest.
unitDetail.rateRuleDeleteConfirmDescription: This will remove the seasonal price override for this unit.
unitDetail.emptyRateRulesDescription: This unit currently uses its base rate for all dates. Add rules for high season, holidays, or special periods.
